diagnosis.what_happened: The orchestrator delegated both analytical computation and narrative authoring to the statistics-agent due to coarse string matching.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Delegating narrative work to a statistical node violated separation of concerns, bypassing specialized typographic safety checks.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Orchestrator must decompose tasks into a strict two-tier architecture: computation (statistics-agent) then authoring (academic-writer).
diagnosis.rationale_why: Specialized agents ensure functional constraints (e.g., academic-writer for complex DOM manipulation, statistics-agent for computational accuracy) are respected without contamination.

desired_behavior: Enforce strict two-tier computational and narrative task decomposition. Route computational tasks (e.g. data generation) to statistics-agent and narrative generation (.docx, .md) to academic-writer.
generalization: Strict separation between analytical computation and academic writing is universally required across all tasks to ensure execution fidelity.

evidence.observed_value: Bleed of narrative scope to computational agent
evidence.threshold_value: Zero instances of `.docx` or `.md` authoring by statistics-agent
